Players Committee card image of [[General Walex Blissex (V)]] (original printing), game text: “While at a war room, at systems where you have two piloted snub fighters, opponent may draw no more than one battle destiny (you may not cancel those destiny draws) and opponent must use +1 Force to move an Imperial starship away.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/generalwalexblissex.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
